column1: 請求按流派ID、等級、付費等級和是否有BD來設定角色屬性；設定未說明具體屬性清單。
column2: Requests setting character attributes by build ID, level, paid level and whether a BD exists; the config does not list the specific attributes.

column1: 請求列印目標單位屬性用於診斷；目標ID留空或為0時使用自己。
column2: Requests printing the target unit's attributes for diagnostics; uses yourself if the target ID is blank or 0.

column1: 請求按選項關閉或開啟無冷卻狀態，影響目前戰鬥測試工作階段。
column2: Requests disabling or enabling the no-cooldown state per the option, affecting the current combat test session.

column1: 請求按選項關閉或開啟傷害波動，影響目前戰鬥測試結果。
column2: Requests disabling or enabling damage variance per the option, affecting current combat test results.

column1: 請求熱重載技能藍圖；設定未說明作用範圍、失敗處理或持久性。
column2: Requests a hot reload of skill blueprints; the config does not describe scope, failure handling or persistence.

column1: 請求向目標新增指定Buff，可指定持續時間；未填時間時讀取Buff設定，目標留空或為0時指向自己。預設按鈕請求成組測試Buff。
column2: Requests adding the specified buff to the target with an optional duration; if no duration is entered it is read from the buff config, and a blank or 0 target means yourself. Preset buttons request groups of test buffs.

column1: 請求從目標移除指定Buff，可選擇按層數刪除；目標留空或為0時指向自己。預設按鈕請求移除成組測試Buff。
column2: Requests removing the specified buff from the target, optionally by stack count; a blank or 0 target means yourself. Preset buttons request removing groups of test buffs.

column1: 請求查詢指定屬性ID；未選擇目標時查看自己，選擇目標時查看目標，用於診斷。
column2: Requests querying the specified attribute ID for diagnostics; shows your own if no target is selected, or the target's if one is selected.

column1: 請求殺死指定目標單位；目標ID留空或為0時會指向自己。
column2: Requests killing the specified target unit; a blank or 0 target ID points to yourself.

column1: 請求把角色傳送到指定地圖ID和可選X/Y座標；座標留空時設定說明使用地圖固定傳送點。
column2: Requests teleporting the character to the specified map ID and optional X/Y coordinates; per the config notes, blank coordinates use the map's fixed teleport point.

column1: 請求顯示玩家目前座標和朝向，用於診斷。
column2: Requests showing the player's current coordinates and facing, for diagnostics.

column1: 請求開啟或關閉所選戰鬥日誌類型，包括傷害、AI、經驗、副本、技能、Buff和狀態機日誌。
column2: Requests enabling or disabling the selected combat log types, including damage, AI, EXP, dungeon, skill, buff and state machine logs.

column1: 請求開啟或關閉傷害範圍快照顯示，用於戰鬥診斷。
column2: Requests enabling or disabling the damage area snapshot display, for combat diagnostics.

column1: 請求把Base等級和Job等級設為下拉選單所選值；目前安裝選項分別顯示40級和10級。
column2: Requests setting Base Level and Job Level to the values selected in the dropdowns; the installed options currently show Lv.40 and Lv.10 respectively.

column1: 請求重設或推進GVG流程；設定說明數字字串定義開始、準備和戰鬥秒數，open開啟GVG，next推進下一階段。
column2: Requests a reset or advance of the GVG flow. The config's number string defines the start, preparation and battle durations in seconds; "open" starts GVG and "next" advances to the next phase.

column1: 請求執行副本enter或leave操作；此列雖然名為「退出副本」，但安裝選項同時提供進入和離開。
column2: Requests a dungeon enter or leave operation. Although this row is named "Exit Dungeon", the installed options provide both enter and leave.

column1: 請求把目標單位陣營設為中立、玩家或怪物。
column2: Requests setting the target unit's faction to Neutral, Player or Monster.

column1: 提供三個聯賽管理預設：免定段條件檢測、批次產生公會和推進到下一階段時間。這些請求可能改變聯賽全域資料或階段。
column2: Provides three league management presets: skip-placement condition check, bulk guild generation, and advance to the next phase time. These requests may change global league data or phases.

column2: Requests disabling or enabling server movement validation; disabling it changes the movement verification rules.

column2: Broadcasts a client event to show or hide the entire game UI.

column2: Controls extra logging for chat messages, used to diagnose public chat behavior.

column1: 調整繪製器後處理狀態，影響畫面效果。
column2: Adjusts the renderer's post-processing state, affecting visual effects.

column1: 調整用戶端畫質控制器是否套用畫質篩選。
column2: Adjusts whether the client graphics quality controller applies quality filtering.

column2: Adds or removes the character model layer from the main camera's rendering.

column1: 控制主光源即時陰影，用於畫面與效能測試。
column2: Controls real-time shadows from the main light, for visual and performance testing.

column2: Starts a Lua debug connection to the entered address; debugging may interrupt script execution.

column2: Deletes client log files, removing diagnostic history.

column2: Requests a reconnect through the network manager to test the connection recovery flow.

column2: When dungeon data exists, shows the current dungeon's event variables and their values.

column2: Calls the client game restart flow, interrupting the current session.

column2: Opens or closes the GM server search panel to find server entries.

column2: Loads and plays the specified cutscene timeline; the callback appends the .asset extension.

column2: Prepares a test character: every option first requests Base 99, Job 40 and feature unlocks, then adds the selected progression resources.

column2: Initializes the messaging SDK and shows the initialization result.

column2: Logs in to the messaging service with the entered account and shows the result.

column2: Checks whether the specified voice channel has been joined and shows the participation status.

column2: Requests joining or leaving the specified voice channel; an extra button leaves all voice channels.

column1: 呼叫指定 Lua 函式並記錄傳回值；參數解析為數字、布林值或文字，函式可能修改遊戲狀態。
column2: Calls the specified Lua function and logs the return value; arguments are parsed as numbers, booleans or text, and the function may modify game state.

column1: 主入口為空；配置和釋放按鈕載入固定測試資源並釋放資源控制代碼。
column2: The main entry is empty; the Allocate and Release buttons load a fixed test resource and release the resource handle.

column1: 切換舊版 GM 面板；內部函式名並不表示開啟背包。
column2: Toggles the legacy GM panel; despite the internal function name, it does not open the inventory.

column1: 切換用戶端 DOTS 動畫，用於繪製和效能測試。
column2: Toggles client DOTS animation, for rendering and performance testing.

column1: 開啟所選副本首通或 MVP 結算介面，並套用選定表現設定。
column2: Opens the first-clear or MVP results screen for the selected dungeon and applies the selected presentation settings.

column1: 調整資源載入器是否啟用最大載入限制。
column2: Adjusts whether the resource loader enables the maximum load limit.

column2: Controls the local GM diagnostic log flag; does not change server permissions.

column1: 將快取日誌寫入磁碟並開啟日誌檔案。
column2: Writes cached logs to disk and opens the log file.

column1: 開啟模型編輯面板，用於檢查和調整角色模型表現。
column2: Opens the model edit panel to inspect and adjust character model presentation.

column2: Opens the Novice Challenge panel through the client UI manager.

column1: 在自動戰鬥目前錨點顯示或隱藏標記，不會改變錨點位置。
column2: Shows or hides a marker at the current auto-battle anchor; does not change the anchor position.

column1: 顯示或隱藏效能面板，檢查執行時測量資料。
column2: Shows or hides the performance panel to inspect runtime measurements.

column1: 啟用或停用用戶端畫質診斷旗標。
column2: Enables or disables the client graphics quality diagnostic flag.

column1: 建立或關閉執行時檢查器，查看目前場景物件和元件。
column2: Creates or closes the runtime inspector to view objects and components in the current scene.

column1: 開啟特效測試面板，預覽特效資源。
column2: Opens the effects test panel to preview effect assets.

column1: 開啟語音服務資訊面板，檢查目前狀態。
column2: Opens the voice service info panel to check its current status.

column1: 開始播放所選預錄測試，或停止目前錄製回放。
column2: Starts playback of the selected prerecorded test, or stops the current recording playback.

column1: 舊載入器輸出資源載入資訊；新載入器分支僅提示此診斷尚未實作。
column2: The old loader outputs resource loading info; the new loader branch only reports that this diagnostic is not implemented yet.

column1: 根據顯示選項啟用或關閉介面拍攝狀態；此回呼不建立影片檔案。
column2: Enables or disables UI capture mode based on the display option; this callback does not create a video file.

column1: 要求指定 Lua 熱修復並在執行中套用；另一個按鈕載入編輯器本機熱修復。
column2: Requests the specified Lua hotfix and applies it at runtime; another button loads the editor's local hotfix.

column1: 設定目標影格率，同時關閉垂直同步。
column2: Sets the target frame rate and disables V-Sync.

column1: 將數值型麥克風音量設定套用於指定語音頻道。
column2: Applies a numeric microphone volume setting to the specified voice channel.

column1: 顯示或更新尋路網格疊層，也可隱藏。
column2: Shows or refreshes the pathfinding navmesh overlay, or hides it.

column1: 透過設定系統套用畫質預設，並更新相關介面。
column2: Applies a graphics quality preset through the settings system and refreshes the related UI.

column2: Adjusts the render interval, separately from the game's main frame rate setting.

column2: Applies the selected configured resolution tier; custom pixel sizes are not accepted.

column2: Sets the render scale as a percentage; the callback divides the input value by 100.

column1: 設定目標選取框、地面圓環、兩者或均不顯示，並更新單位 HUD。

column2: Passes a numeric texture quality setting to the renderer, affecting texture display and resource cost.

column1: 控制雨、雪或反射；所檢查原始碼在調整反射時也會開啟雨控制器和下雨。

column2: Shows or hides the alternate EasyGM tool UI.

column2: Shows or hides the in-game diagnostic log console.
